info.title: Box Platform API
info.description: [Box Platform](https://developer.box.com) provides functionality to provide access to content stored within [Box](https://box.com). It provides endpoints for basic manipulation of files and folders, management of users within an enterprise, as well as more complex topics such as legal holds and retention policies.

get.summary: List Automate workflows defined as callable actions
get.description:
Returns workflow actions from Automate for a folder, using the
`WORKFLOW` action category.

parameters.name: folder_id
parameters.description:
The unique identifier that represent a folder.

The ID for any folder can be determined
by visiting this folder in the web application
and copying the ID from the URL. For example,
for the URL `https://*.app.box.com/folder/123`
the `folder_id` is `123`.

The root folder of a Box account is
always represented by the ID `0`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: marker
parameters.description:
Defines the position marker at which to begin returning results. This is
used when paginating using marker-based pagination.

200.description: Returns workflow actions that can be manually started.

post.description: Starts an Automate workflow manually by using a workflow action ID and file IDs.
Creates a Box Note (`.boxnote` file) from supported source content. See the `content_format` field for supported formats.

post.description:
Initiates a Document Split job for the supplied source file. The job runs
asynchronously; clients can poll the returned job ID to track progress.

All split-specific input lives under `split_input`. When
`split_input.split_type` is `manual`, provide
`split_input.split_definition` (continuous page ranges; `version` may be
omitted or `v_1`). When `split_input.split_type` is `page_selection`,
provide `split_input.page_selection` (non-linear page segments; `version`
may be omitted or `v_2`). `split_input.prompt` must not be provided for
either of those variants. When `split_input.split_type` is `smart`,
`split_input.prompt` is required and neither
`split_input.split_definition` nor `split_input.page_selection` must be
provided.

split_input.prompt: Split this contract into one file per signed section.

post.description:
Runs a query to discover Box items using a logical predicate, similar to a SQL
WHERE clause. The predicate can filter across multiple metadata templates and
item fields in a single request. Results can be sorted, paginated with markers,
and shaped with fields so each entry includes additional item or metadata
attributes.

This is the item-retrieval endpoint in the Query API (version 2026.0). Unlike
the [Metadata Query API](https://developer.box.com/reference/post-metadata-queries-execute-read),
it is not limited to a single metadata template or to files and folders. For
totals and grouped metrics over the same predicates, use
[Query Insights](https://developer.box.com/reference/v2026.0/post-query-insights)
instead of paging through every matching item.

For predicate syntax, parameters, examples, pagination behavior, and error
codes, see the
[Box Query guide](https://developer.box.com/guides/query/box-query). For shared
response schemas, including Query results and result entries, see
[Query resources](https://developer.box.com/reference/v2026.0/query-resources).

200.description: Returns a paginated list of items matching the query.

400.description:
Returned when the query could not be parsed, the request body fails schema
validation, a referenced scope is not valid, or an unexpected JSON type was
provided.

401.description:
Returned when the access token provided in the `Authorization` header is
missing, not valid, or expired.

403.description:
Returned when the query matched too many items, or too many inaccessible
items, to be processed.

404.description:
Returned when a referenced metadata template or item does not exist, or the
user does not have access to it.

429.description: Returned when the enterprise exceeds the allowed request rate.

500.description: Returned when an unexpected server error occurs while processing the query.

post.description:
Computes aggregated metrics over Box items matching a query predicate.
Filters are applied first, followed by optional grouping, after which the
requested metrics (such as `sum`, `avg`, `min`, `max`, and `count`) are
computed for each resulting group or over the entire filtered dataset.

400.description:
Returned when the query could not be parsed, the request body fails schema
validation, or an unexpected JSON type was provided.

401.description:
Returned when the access token provided in the `Authorization` header is
missing, not valid, or expired.

403.description: Returned when the query is restricted for this enterprise or scope.

404.description:
Returned when a referenced metadata template does not exist, or the user
does not have access to it.

429.description: Returned when the enterprise exceeds the allowed request rate.

500.description: Returned when an unexpected server error occurs while computing insights.

DocumentSplit.description:
A standard representation of a Document Split job. The job represents a
request to split a paginated source document into multiple files based on
either a manual set of page ranges, a non-linear page selection, or a
smart prompt-driven analysis.

id.description: The unique identifier for the Document Split job.

status.description: The current state of the Document Split job.

allOf.description:
The caller-supplied input that was used to perform the split. The
shape mirrors the request: for a `manual` split, `split_input`
contains `split_type` and `split_definition`; for a `page_selection`
split, `split_input` contains `split_type` and `page_selection`; for
a `smart` split, `split_input` contains `split_type` and the
caller-supplied `prompt`. For smart splits, the page ranges that Box
produced are exposed under `output.split_definition`.

output.description:
The result of the Document Split job. `null` until the job has produced
output.

QueryInsightEntry.description:
A single computed insight entry, containing its grouping keys (if applicable)
and the computed metrics.

The grouping key values associated with the entry. Contains one value per

`other` entries.

type.description:
The type of insight entry, indicating how the associated metrics are
aggregated.

metrics.description:
A map of metric aliases to their computed results. For `other` entries, the
count is reported under the `totalCountBeyondTopGroups` key.

QueryInsightEntry.title: Query insight entry

QueryInsights.description: The computed results of an insights request, as a list of insight entries.

QueryInsights.title: Query insights

QueryInsightsGroupBy.description:
Defines a single grouping criterion for an insights request. Currently only a
single grouping field is supported.

field.description:
The fully qualified field name to group by. Supports metadata and item
properties.

bucket_limit.description: The maximum number of buckets to return for the grouping. Defaults to `5`.

QueryInsightsGroupBy.title: Query insights group by

QueryInsightsMetricDefinition.description:
Defines a single metric to compute, including the aggregation function and the
field it is applied to.

field.description: The fully qualified field name on which the metric is computed.

QueryInsightsMetricDefinition.title: Query insights metric definition

QueryInsightsRequestBody.description:
Request body describing the filtering, grouping, and metrics for an insights
computation.

query.description:
The filtering and grouping definition. Filters are applied first, followed
by grouping, before metrics are computed.

predicate.description:
A logical expression used to filter the dataset prior to metric
computation, similar to an SQL `WHERE` clause. May include
named parameters referenced as `:placeholder`.

params.description:
A map of placeholder names (without the `:` prefix) to their values.
Required only when the predicate contains parameter placeholders. The
type of each value must match the type of the field it is compared to.

ancestors.description:
Restricts results to items contained within any of the specified
ancestors. The user must have access to every listed ancestor. When
omitted, insights are computed across all accessible items.

group_by.description:
Defines how data is grouped for insights computation. Currently only a
single grouping field is supported.

metrics.description:
A map of user-defined metric aliases to their definitions. A maximum of 10
metrics may be defined. Each alias must be a unique, non-empty string of up
to 256 characters, containing only letters, digits, `_`, `-`, or `.`, and
must not start with a digit, `_`, `-`, or `.`. May be empty to request
only a total count.

QueryInsightsRequestBody.title: Query insights request body

QueryOrderBy.description:
A single sorting criterion applied to the query result set. Multiple criteria
are applied sequentially in the order specified.

field_key.description: The fully qualified field key to sort by.

direction.description: The direction in which results are ordered.

QueryOrderBy.title: Query order by

QueryRequestBody.description:
Request body describing the query to run, including the filtering predicate,
optional sorting, pagination, and the fields to return for each result.

query.description:
The query definition, including the filtering predicate and its optional
parameters and ancestor restrictions.

predicate.description:
A logical expression used to filter the dataset, similar to an SQL
`WHERE` clause. May include named parameters referenced as
`:placeholder`.

params.description:
A map of placeholder names (without the `:` prefix) to their values.
Required only when the predicate contains parameter placeholders. The
type of each value must match the type of the field it is compared to.

ancestors.description:
Restricts results to the specified ancestor entities and their
recursive descendants. The user must have read access to every listed
ancestor.

order_by.description:
The sorting criteria for the result set. Entries are applied sequentially
to define multi-level sorting.

limit.description:
The maximum number of results to return. Defaults to `50` when not
provided.

fields.description:
Controls which additional fields are included in each result entry. Each
value must be one of: a fully qualified item field key (for example
`box:item:name`), a metadata template key to hydrate the full template (for
example `enterprise_12345678:project`), or a specific metadata template
field key to hydrate a single field from the template (for example
`enterprise_12345678:project:name`). When omitted, entries include only the
item type and identifier.

marker.description:
An opaque token returned from a previous response, used to continue
retrieval. When provided, all other request parameters must exactly match
those of the original request.

QueryRequestBody.title: Query request body

QueryResultEntry.description:
A single item matching the query. Always includes the item `type` and `id`.
If a `fields` parameter was specified in the request, then additional item
and/or metadata fields will be provided.

id.description: The unique identifier of the matching item.

type.description: The type of the matching item.

QueryResultEntry.title: Query result entry

QueryResults.description:
A paginated list of items matching the query, using milestone-based marker
pagination.

entries.description: The list of items matching the query predicate.

next_marker.description:
The marker for the start of the next page of results. When `null`, there
are no further results available.

limit.description:
The limit that was used for this request. This will be the same as the limit query 
parameter unless that value exceeded the maximum value allowed.

QueryResults.title: Query results
